records.content: The bEpic OIIO/OCIO node classes for color-managed image I/O are bepic_imageLoad (load EXR/PNG via OIIO), bepic_colorTransform (OCIO color convert, e.g. input "ACES - ACEScg" to output "Output - sRGB", clamp default true), and bEpic_imageSave (save via OIIO with file_format png/exr/etc); search_nodes only matches literal substrings, so search the "bepic_" prefix rather than terms like "load" or "read" to find them.

The bEpic_imageSave node requires the audio_format input ("wav" is fine) even when saving a still image with no audio, or validation fails with "missing required input audio_format"; and its auto_version input must be set to false for stills, because when true it wraps each save in a versioned subfolder (e.g. prefix_00001\) and bakes that version token into the filename instead of writing prefix.####.png directly into the target folder.

A registered template "acescg_to_srgb" performs a 3-node bEpic OCIO conversion (load EXR -> ACES - ACEScg to Output - sRGB -> save 16-bit PNG); to batch it over a folder of non-contiguous EXR frames, run one submit_prompt per file (the load node's sequence mode only handles contiguous ranges), patching node 1 image_path and node 3 first_frame per frame, with auto_version false so PNGs land flat in the target folder.
